summary: Intermittent websocket half-close after corporate TLS rekey -> trailing 'done' envelope never arrives
description: Issue summary: Customer reports intermittent websocket sessions that appear to close from the server side after a TLS rekey performed by their corporate TLS-inspecting proxy. The stream is truncated: the final JSON envelope with status/done metadata is never received, leaving the client waiting indefinitely. Impact: Multiple production users at Acme AI Labs experience truncated generations and must reissue requests; affects business-critical inference pipelines. Observed first at ~2026-03-09 22:15 PST and recurred several times. Environment: prod cluster behind ALB -> CloudFront -> corporate TLS-inspection -> customer client. No code changes on Redwood side around times of first occurrence.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer establishes long-running websocket streaming request against /v1/streams with model redwood-1-large. 2) While the model is streaming a ~4000-token completion, customer network triggers TLS session renegotiation / rekey (corporate proxy performs active MITM). 3) Connection experiences a short TCP-level close followed by client reconnect; client tries to resume but never receives final 'done' envelope or terminal metadata. 4) Repeating with curl/wscat behind same proxy triggers the same truncated stream ~30% of runs. Reproducer cURL/websocket notes included in logs.

investigation_notes: Initial analysis (Support): pattern correlates to external TLS rekey events; connection transitions show half-closed state on server logs.
SRE step: Captured pcap from edge node and confirmed short TCP FIN followed by immediate SYN from same client IP; no backend worker crash seen.

Hypothesis: Proxy-inserted TLS rekey modifies client TCP/TLS state in a way that our edge/keepalive handling treats as half-close and does not queue or persist terminal envelope to resume snapshot. Resume path then rejects resume due to ephemeral snapshot mismatch.
Reproducer: Engineering reproduced by running corporate TLS-inspection appliance (testbox) that forces TLS rekey mid-stream; observed identical symptom in ~4/10 runs.

Edge behavior detail: When FIN arrives while last chunk is buffered but not flushed to persistent stream-snapshot, the server sets session state to HALF_CLOSED and GC probes remove pending terminal metadata after 10s. This window aligns with observed data loss.
proposed_next_steps:
- Short term workaround: advise customer to disable mid-stream TLS rekey/rewrite on corp proxy for inference traffic or mark Redwood endpoints in proxy bypass list.
- Medium term: implement atomic flush of terminal envelope to durable snapshot before transitioning session to HALF_CLOSED; add aggressive snapshot checkpoint on any FIN/close path.
- Add metric/trace to alert when session enters HALF_CLOSED with non-flushed-terminal for >5s.
- Run PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1219 to staging with instrumentation and reproduce under testbox.
resolution_notes: (Pending) No customer-visible resolution yet. Customer accepted bypass workaround to unblock pipelines; engineering own implementation plan queued.
